name: skip
title: Skip link
description: The first link of a page, shown while it has focus, that jumps past the navigation.
use: Once on every page, as the first element of the body, pointing at the id of the main region. A reader who starts with the Tab key meets it first and can go straight to the content; nobody else sees it. Give the target tabindex="-1" so focus moves with the jump in every browser.

instead.when: The link is part of a sentence or a row of navigation
The headings of the page are offered as a list

keyboard.action: From the top of the page: shows the link
Jumps to the content the link points at

classes.name: skip
classes.description: The link, on an anchor that points at an id: fixed 8px inside the top corner as a small control of ink, out of sight until it has focus

states.name: focused
states.description: The link drops into view and can be pressed

properties.name: --skip-layer
properties.description: The z-index it stands at, over a sticky navbar

example:
Skip to content
